asked: Rerun drop-from-T0 findings with price-dependent dip thresholds: 5¢ when the side’s T0 Yes is in 20–49, 3¢ when T0 Yes is in 50–89. How does gap-buy frequency and optimistic lock edge compare to the uniform-dip 2026-11-02 report (esp. both ≥5¢ / ≥10¢)?
plain: Same max-dip definition as 2026-11-02 (T0 Yes − min Yes after T0). Band rule assigns each side its own required dip from that side’s T0: D=5¢ on [0.20, 0.49], D=3¢ on [0.50, 0.89] (exactly 0.50 → 3¢). Sides with T0 < 0.20 or ≥ 0.90 are excluded from the band rule but remain in the uniform-dip decile tables. Both-sides band hit requires both legs eligible and each clearing its own D. Optimistic cost = T0a−Da + T0b−Db.
limitation: Optimistic both-side fills at exactly T0−D ignore queue, ask/trade gap, and fees. Band edge is thinner than uniform −10¢ (System G sketch) because D is only 3–5¢. Same source books as 2026-11-02; default rebuild is report-only from cached Kalshi/Poly jsonl + dense Oct 21 HTML. Local price_memory is not on this cloud VM.
